# Backend Developer Roadmap

## Foundations
- Node.js runtime, npm, module patterns (CommonJS/ESM)
- HTTP: methods, status codes, headers, cookies, CORS
- JSON APIs, validation, error handling middleware

## Core stack
- Express.js routing, middleware chain, async error handling
- MongoDB: schemas, indexes, aggregation, ObjectId patterns
- Authentication: session vs JWT vs Firebase token verification
- Real-time: Socket.io rooms, presence, message persistence

## Architecture
- MVC or modular routes/controllers/services
- Environment variables, secrets management
- Rate limiting, input sanitization, security headers
- Logging and structured errors for production

## Intermediate skills
- Database indexing for chat and user queries
- File uploads (Cloudinary), pagination, filtering
- Mentor matching algorithms (skill normalization, fuzzy match)
- Testing: Supertest, integration tests against test DB

## Advanced
- Microservices vs monolith tradeoffs
- Caching (Redis), message queues
- Docker, cloud deploy (Railway, Render, AWS)
- Observability: health checks, metrics

## Portfolio projects
- MERN mentorship platform with chat and ratings
- REST API with role-based access
- Webhook consumer (payments, notifications)
- Background jobs for email digests

## Skill gaps to watch
- Missing indexes → slow queries on conversations/messages
- No validation on request bodies → security risk
- Blocking sync code in hot paths → scale issues

# Career Guides for Tech Learners

## Choosing a direction
- Map **teachSkills** (strengths) vs **learnSkills** (growth) to role families: Frontend, Backend, Full-stack, Data, DevOps.
- Align **teachLevel** and **learnLevel** (Beginner → Mastery) with project difficulty and mentor expectations.
- Use education and portfolio to signal credibility; supplement with GitHub and live demos.

## Job search strategy
- Target roles where your teach skills overlap job requirements; use learn skills as upside narrative.
- Network via mentorship platforms: offer help in strong skills while learning weak areas.
- Prepare STAR stories from collaborative projects (matching, chat, ratings).

## Skill gap analysis method
1. List target role required skills (from job posts or roadmaps).
2. Mark owned (teach), learning (learn), missing.
3. Prioritize gaps that unblock portfolio pieces in 2–4 weeks.
4. Pair each gap with one course module + one project task.

## Learning habits
- 70% building, 20% reading docs, 10% community (mentors, peer review).
- Ship weekly: small PRs, demo links, changelog in README.
- Request feedback from mentors on code structure, not just syntax.

## Bangladesh / university context
- Leverage university projects (e.g., Daffodil International University) as case studies.
- Contribute to open source or local hackathons for visibility.
- Balance FYP deadlines with portfolio polish—one flagship app beats five half-done repos.

## Using mentorship effectively
- Come with specific questions: "Review my React state design" vs "teach me everything."
- Match mentors whose teachSkills cover your top 3 learnSkills.
- Follow up with implemented feedback to build reputation on the platform.

# Data Science & ML Roadmap

## Foundations
- Python, NumPy, Pandas, Jupyter workflows
- Statistics: distributions, hypothesis testing, correlation vs causation
- SQL for data extraction and joins

## Visualization & communication
- Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly
- Storytelling with dashboards (Streamlit, Dash)
- Clear metrics for stakeholders

## Machine learning
- Scikit-learn: regression, classification, clustering, cross-validation
- Feature engineering, imbalanced data, leakage avoidance
- Model evaluation: precision/recall, ROC-AUC, confusion matrix

## Deep learning (optional path)
- PyTorch or TensorFlow basics
- NLP embeddings, transformers overview
- LangChain + RAG for career/advisor products

## MLOps lite
- Version datasets and models
- Reproducible notebooks → scripts
- API deployment (FastAPI) for model serving

## Projects
- Skill recommendation engine from user profiles
- Mentor match scoring analysis and A/B metrics
- Sentiment on chat messages for engagement insights
- RAG career advisor over roadmap documents

## Career fit
- Analyst: SQL + viz + business questions
- ML Engineer: production APIs, monitoring, retraining
- Data Scientist: experimentation, causal inference, research

# DevOps & Platform Roadmap

## Foundations
- Linux CLI, processes, permissions, networking basics
- Git branching, PR reviews, conventional commits
- CI/CD concepts: build, test, deploy pipelines

## Containers & cloud
- Docker: Dockerfile, compose for local MERN stacks
- Environment parity: dev/staging/prod variables
- Deploy Node + MongoDB (Atlas) + static React CDN

## Infrastructure as code (intro)
- Terraform or Pulumi overview
- Managed databases, secrets in vault/parameter store
- HTTPS, DNS, CDN for frontend assets

## Observability
- Health endpoints (`/`, `/health`)
- Log aggregation, error alerting
- Uptime checks for API and WebSocket server

## Security
- `.env` never in git; rotate leaked credentials
- CORS allowlists, helmet-style headers
- Dependency scanning (npm audit)

## MERN-specific ops
- Socket.io sticky sessions behind load balancers
- MongoDB indexes for chat and user_list collections
- Backup strategy for conversations and ratings

## Career path
- Platform engineer: reliability, cost, automation
- SRE: SLOs, incident response, postmortems
- Full-stack with DevOps fluency: ship features and own deploy

# Frontend Developer Roadmap

## Foundations
- HTML5 semantic structure, accessibility (ARIA, keyboard nav)
- CSS: Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, Tailwind or modern utility workflows
- JavaScript ES6+: async/await, modules, closures, event loop

## Core stack
- React (components, hooks, context, performance)
- TypeScript for scalable apps
- React Router for SPA navigation
- State: Context, Zustand, or Redux Toolkit when complexity grows

## Styling & UX
- Tailwind CSS, component libraries (shadcn/ui)
- Framer Motion for micro-interactions
- Design systems, dark mode, responsive SaaS layouts

## Tooling
- Vite, npm/pnpm, ESLint, Prettier
- Git workflow, code review habits
- Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright for E2E

## Intermediate → job-ready
- REST API integration, auth flows (Firebase/OAuth)
- Performance: lazy loading, memoization, bundle analysis
- SEO basics, meta tags for marketing pages
- Deploy: Vercel, Netlify, CI/CD basics

## Portfolio projects
- Skill-matching or mentorship dashboard (like Collaborative Skill Engine)
- E-commerce UI with cart and checkout mock
- Real-time chat UI with Socket.io
- Admin analytics dashboard with charts

## Career milestones
- Junior: ship 2–3 polished React apps with README and live demo
- Mid: lead feature slices, write tests, mentor juniors on CSS/React patterns
- Senior: architecture, design systems, accessibility audits, cross-team API contracts

# Skill Learning Playbook

## Skill levels (platform-aligned)
- **Beginner**: syntax, guided tutorials, clone projects
- **Intermediate**: build features independently, debug API integration
- **Advanced**: optimize, test, document tradeoffs
- **Mastery**: teach others, design systems, review architecture

## Learning a new skill in 4 weeks
- Week 1: official docs + 10 small exercises
- Week 2: mini feature in existing project (e.g., add chart to dashboard)
- Week 3: standalone micro-project showcasing the skill
- Week 4: refactor + write blog/README explaining decisions

## JavaScript ecosystem
- Master one framework deeply (React) before chasing every meta-framework
- Learn Node + Express alongside React for full MERN fluency
- TypeScript: adopt after comfortable with JS patterns

## Soft skills for collaboration platforms
- Write clear connection requests referencing shared skills
- Rate mentors fairly with constructive comments
- Maintain conversation context—summarize goals before asking for help

## Recommended next skills by goal
- **Frontend Developer**: TypeScript, testing, accessibility, performance
- **Backend Developer**: auth hardening, indexes, API design, observability
- **Full-stack**: deploy pipeline, one cloud provider, basic Docker
- **Data track**: SQL, Pandas, one ML project with evaluation metrics
- **DevOps track**: Docker, CI, monitoring for existing MERN app

## Project ideas tied to skills
- Add AI career advisor (RAG + user profile) — full-stack + ML literacy
- Improve mentor matching with explainable match scores
- Chat analytics: response time, topic tags from messages
